{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSztd1SiDQtZJEEF4NCV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01P7Q5gyNzw9pRAMXzGLL8SX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/cli/dispatcher.py","content":"\"\"\"Command registry and dispatch.\n\nCommand stories register a handler under a command name at import time. `main` hands the\nremaining arguments to the handler and returns the handler's exit code.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nUSAGE_ERROR = 2\n\n_handlers: dict[str, Callable[[list[str]], int]] = {}\n\n\ndef register_command(name: str, handler: Callable[[list[str]], int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Map a command name to its handler; registering a name again replaces the handler.\"\"\"\n    _handlers[name] = handler\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Dispatch `argv[0]` to its registered handler and return the exit code.\"\"\"\n    args = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)\n    if not args:\n        print(\"usage: fxrates <command> [arguments...]\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    handler = _handlers.get(args[0])\n    if handler is None:\n        print(f\"error: unknown command: {args[0]}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    return handler(args[1:])\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2765,"cache_read_input_tokens":36080,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2765},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"48327808-066a-458d-a62c-08a54b8d6603","uuid":"88a10a88-3da8-41c1-8d4d-e4fac2f10b15","timestamp":"2026-10-27T15:44:19.465Z","request_id":"req_011CgSztckK6G4nFLKy8PbW4","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01P7Q5gyNzw9pRAMXzGLL8SX":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/cli/dispatcher.py","content":"\"\"\"Command registry and dispatch.\n\nCommand stories register a handler under a command name at import time. `main` hands the\nremaining arguments to the handler and returns the handler's exit code.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nUSAGE_ERROR = 2\n\n_handlers: dict[str, Callable[[list[str]], int]] = {}\n\n\ndef register_command(name: str, handler: Callable[[list[str]], int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Map a command name to its handler; registering a name again replaces the handler.\"\"\"\n    _handlers[name] = handler\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Dispatch `argv[0]` to its registered handler and return the exit code.\"\"\"\n    args = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)\n    if not args:\n        print(\"usage: fxrates <command> [arguments...]\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    handler = _handlers.get(args[0])\n    if handler is None:\n        print(f\"error: unknown command: {args[0]}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    return handler(args[1:])\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01P7Q5gyNzw9pRAMXzGLL8SX","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/cli/dispatcher.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"48327808-066a-458d-a62c-08a54b8d6603","uuid":"65a86de2-64ca-4eb7-9ae3-4e7cfee7b1ab","timestamp":"2026-10-27T15:44:19.508Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/cli/dispatcher.py","content":"\"\"\"Command registry and dispatch.\n\nCommand stories register a handler under a command name at import time. `main` hands the\nremaining arguments to the handler and returns the handler's exit code.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nUSAGE_ERROR = 2\n\n_handlers: dict[str, Callable[[list[str]], int]] = {}\n\n\ndef register_command(name: str, handler: Callable[[list[str]], int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Map a command name to its handler; registering a name again replaces the handler.\"\"\"\n    _handlers[name] = handler\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Dispatch `argv[0]` to its registered handler and return the exit code.\"\"\"\n    args = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)\n    if not args:\n        print(\"usage: fxrates <command> [arguments...]\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    handler = _handlers.get(args[0])\n    if handler is None:\n        print(f\"error: unknown command: {args[0]}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return USAGE_ERROR\n    return handler(args[1:])\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01P7Q5gyNzw9pRAMXzGLL8SX","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MG7Ap4KNj2MDZYE3cDeoAv","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the FxRates suite.\n2\t\n3\tTests never open a network connection. Any attempt to connect a socket fails the test, so an\n4\taccidental download cannot slip through a suite that is meant to run offline.\n5\t\"\"\"\n6\t\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport socket\n10\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n11\tfrom pathlib import Path\n12\t\n13\timport pytest\n14\t\n15\t\n16\tclass NetworkAccessError(RuntimeError):\n17\t    \"\"\"Raised when a test attempts to open a network connection.\"\"\"\n18\t\n19\t\n20\tdef _refuse_connection(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> None:\n21\t    raise NetworkAccessError(\"tests must not open network connections\")\n22\t\n23\t\n24\t@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\n25\tdef _block_network(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Iterator[None]:\n26\t    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect\", _refuse_connection)\n27\t    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, \"create_connection\", _refuse_connection)\n28\t    yield\n29\t\n30\t\n31\t@pytest.fixture\n32\tdef project_root() -> Path:\n33\t    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n34\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"48327808-066a-458d-a62c-08a54b8d6603","uuid":"1de43f4b-b50c-455d-a760-aa295db89c33","timestamp":"2026-10-27T15:44:26.069Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/tests/conftest.py","content":"\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the FxRates suite.\n\nTests never open a network connection. Any attempt to connect a socket fails the test, so an\naccidental download cannot slip through a suite that is meant to run offline.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport socket\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\n\nclass NetworkAccessError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a test attempts to open a network connection.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _refuse_connection(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> None:\n    raise NetworkAccessError(\"tests must not open network connections\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef _block_network(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Iterator[None]:\n    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect\", _refuse_connection)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, \"create_connection\", _refuse_connection)\n    yield\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n","numLines":34,"startLine":1,"totalLines":34}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01MG7Ap4KNj2MDZYE3cDeoAv","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

This scans production source only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport ast\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nFORBIDDEN = {\"sqlite3\", \"psycopg\", \"psycopg2\", \"sqlalchemy\", \"asyncpg\"}\nPACKAGES = [\"cli\", \"app_server\"]\n\n\ndef _imported_top_level_names(source: str) -> set[str]:\n    names: set[str] = set()\n    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)):\n        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):\n            names.update(alias.name.split(\".\")[0] for alias in node.names)\n        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module and node.level == 0:\n            names.add(node.module.split(\".\")[0])\n    return names\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"package\", PACKAGES)\ndef test_package_imports_no_database_driver(project_root: Path, package: str) -> None:\n    sources = sorted((project_root / package).rglob(\"*.py\"))\n    assert sources, f\"{package} has no source files to check\"\n\n    offending = {\n        path.relative_to(project_root).as_posix(): sorted(_imported_top_level_names(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) & FORBIDDEN)\n        for path in sources\n    }\n\n    assert {path: names for path, names in offending.items() if names} == {}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_018V6xzzv99E4uQJvKwFFKew","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

The `fxrates` launcher is POSIX sh with the executable bit set. It activates `.venv` when present and runs `python -m cli \"$@\"`.\n- **app_server**: `create_app()` returns a new FastAPI instance that includes `app_server.routes.router`.
